csheets.text: Compass at 430 by 932 pt, 11 in tablet and scan modes

fflows.text: Leadership flows with tap and keystroke counts

wl.text: Same screens, two tenant brands, tokens only

n-AtlasSignIn.text:
Interaction and keys
Passkey is the one primary action; Apple, Google and email link follow, password and SSO are links. Enter submits the focused method. Session expiry reopens this as a dialog over the page and keeps unsaved input.

Responsive
Auth template: 400 px card centered on the surface ground at every width; footer links wrap below 375 px.

Accessibility
Focus order: passkey, Apple, Google, email field, email link, password, SSO, footer. One h1. Email field uses autocomplete username webauthn so the browser offers passkeys inline. Errors are announced with role alert.

n-AtlasMfa.text:
Interaction and keys
Typing 6 digits verifies automatically; Verify is the fallback. Security key or platform authenticator is offered first by the browser. Recovery code and switch account are links.

Responsive
Same Auth card at every width.

Accessibility
Code field uses inputmode numeric and autocomplete one-time-code. The info alert is announced politely. Wrong code: the field names the problem and the fix in one sentence.

n-AtlasOnboarding.text:
Interaction and keys
Wizard: Back and Next, Cmd or Ctrl+Enter for Next, progress saved per step. The jurisdiction combobox lists Bible tab 11 codes; GB, MX, AE and SA are declared but unpopulated and refuse with No Answer. Checklist matches the eight first-run steps in Section 11.7.

Responsive
Form column 640 px with the checklist beside it; below 1024 px the checklist wraps under the form and the stepper scrolls sideways.

Accessibility
Stepper is an ordered list with aria-current on the step. Combobox follows the ARIA 1.2 pattern, arrows move, Enter selects. Landmarks: header, main, aside.

n-AtlasHome.text:
Interaction and keys
C creates a record anywhere, Cmd or Ctrl+K opens the command menu, G then H returns Home. My Work rows show state, owner, next date and the next action on hover; E completes, A approves. Inbox items Done with E, Snooze with H.

Responsive
Sidebar 240 px from 1024 px up; a drawer from the menu button below 1024 px; below 768 px the bottom bar shows Home, Inbox, Search, My Work, Menu. Two columns stack when the content is narrower than two 420 px columns; tiles go 3, 2, 1. My Work rows reflow by the width of the list, below 720 px, not the viewport.

Accessibility
Landmarks: nav (sidebar), main, banner row. One h1 with h2 per region. Stat deltas are text, never color alone. Inbox counts are announced politely when they change.

n-AtlasProject.text:
Interaction and keys
Project tabs follow Section 4.5.4 order and scroll sideways. Scope picker filters every tab. Gate readiness lists canon G3 criteria; each gap carries the action that clears it, and Enter Gate 4 activates when the last blocker clears.

Responsive
Readiness and summary sit side by side from 1024 px and stack below; tabs scroll; key dates keep a two-column grid down to 640 px.

Accessibility
Gate criteria are a list; results use icon plus word. Presence avatars have a text label. Tabs use the ARIA tabs pattern with arrow keys.

n-AtlasScope.text:
Interaction and keys
Scope tree: arrows move, Right expands, Left collapses, Enter selects and filters every tab. E opens element selection. Reconciliation rows open the capability document.

Responsive
Tree column 260 to 300 px beside content; below 1024 px the tree moves above the tables. Element table scrolls inside its region.

Accessibility
Tree uses role tree with aria-expanded. Staleness is text with an icon. Unpriced element shows Unpriced, never $0.00.

n-AtlasSchedule.text:
Interaction and keys
Drag a bar to reschedule; dependents preview before release, Escape cancels. Keyboard: Space picks up, arrows move by a day, Space drops. Double booking is flagged in place before release. Baseline and critical path are toggles.

Responsive
Timeline scrolls inside its labeled region at every width; header controls wrap. Below 768 px the Timeline view is offered read-only and List becomes default.

Accessibility
Each bar has an accessible name with dates and state. Drag steps are announced. The table view is the accessible alternative to the chart.

n-AtlasRecords.text:
Interaction and keys
J and K move, X selects, Shift+click selects a range, Cmd or Ctrl+A selects loaded rows. The bulk bar shows only actions every selected record allows. Filters, sort and grouping carry across view types.

Responsive
Rows reflow below 1024 px: state and title on line one, metadata on line two, action at the end. Below 768 px rows become stacked cards with the three key fields.

Accessibility
List uses role list with labeled rows; selected state is aria-selected. Bulk bar is a toolbar announced when it appears.

n-AtlasBoard.text:
Interaction and keys
Drag cards between states; keyboard path is Space, arrows, Space, with announcements. A move shows an Undo toast for 8 seconds. Add Record lives at the end of each column.

Responsive
Columns scroll sideways in a region; on phones Board becomes a compact state-grouped list.

Accessibility
Columns are labeled groups with counts. Cards are buttons opening the side peek. Moves are announced with the new state.

n-AtlasPeek.text:
Interaction and keys
Selecting a row opens the side peek; J and K move between records without closing it; Cmd or Ctrl+Enter opens the full page; Escape closes. Properties edit in place. QR code continues the record in Compass.

Responsive
Peek is 560 px, resizable 440 to 960; below 768 px it opens full screen.

Accessibility
Peek is a complementary region labeled with the record key. Focus moves to the title on open and returns to the row on close. Comments and reactions are labeled.

n-AtlasBudget.text:
Interaction and keys
Spreadsheet speed: arrows move, Enter edits, Tab commits, fill handle copies. Grade switch recalculates amounts; amounts are derived from qty times rate and never stored. GL posts by URID class (5000 to 5500, 8000 to 5800).

Responsive
Grid scrolls in its region with pinned first columns; tiles reflow 3, 2, 1. Below 768 px the grid is read-only with stacked line cards.

Accessibility
Grid follows the ARIA grid pattern with row and column headers. Unpriced lines read Unpriced. Totals row is announced as a summary.

n-AtlasPurchaseOrder.text:
Interaction and keys
Three-way match compares ordered, received and invoiced per line; mismatches block approval of that line only. A approves matched lines, Hold Invoice pauses payment. Credit request opens a message to the vendor.

Responsive
Record layout: content left, 320 px properties right; properties drop below content under 1024 px. Match table scrolls in its region.

Accessibility
Match state is icon plus word. Banner is role alert. Property list is a description list.

n-AtlasAdvancing.text:
Interaction and keys
Recipient by section heatmap shows every outstanding item on one screen; select a cell to open that submission. Remind Outstanding sends to only the incomplete cells. Sections reorder by drag or keyboard.

Responsive
Sections and heatmap sit side by side above 1024 px and stack below; the heatmap scrolls in its region.

Accessibility
Heatmap is a real table with row and column headers; each cell carries a text state for screen readers. Legend repeats states as text.

n-AtlasPipeline.text:
Interaction and keys
Board by application state from Section 4.4.4. Drag to move stage; Send Offers acts on the shortlisted column. Pool members get early access. Do Not Engage flags never show here.

Responsive
Board scrolls sideways; fill bar wraps under the opportunity picker.

Accessibility
Each card names the applicant and their status. Fill rate is a labeled progress bar with a text value.

n-AtlasCrew.text:
Interaction and keys
Drag people from the availability list onto shifts; Space, arrows and Space on keyboard. Overtime and double booking warn before assignment. Fill bar updates live.

Responsive
The availability list sits under the schedule at every Atlas width, so neither is cut; the schedule scrolls in its region at 1024 px.

Accessibility
Resource schedule is a grid with person and day headers. Warnings are text, not color only. Overtime uses OTR-001 numbers.

n-AtlasTimesheets.text:
Interaction and keys
Split view: list on the left, timesheet on the right. A approves, R rejects with a reason, Shift+A approves every clean sheet. Approve a queue of 20 in under 60 s. Undo toast for 8 seconds.

Responsive
Split view list collapses to a single column below 768 px and opens the detail as a full screen.

Accessibility
List is a listbox with aria-selected. Punch table has headers. Edited punches are flagged with text.

n-AtlasDispatch.text:
Interaction and keys
New incidents appear at the top of the queue within 2 s. A assigns, Shift+E escalates, E resolves. Severity reads as icon, edge color and word. Map pins match the queue.

Responsive
Queue and map side by side above 1024 px; below, the queue sits above the map. Map scrolls in its region.

Accessibility
Queue is a live region announcing new incidents politely and Severity 1 assertively. Map has a list alternative (the queue).

n-AtlasAccessGrid.text:
Interaction and keys
Space toggles a grant, arrows move, Shift+arrows select a range. Changes sync to Compass scanners within a minute, offline included. Badge preview updates with the category.

Responsive
Grid scrolls in its region; badge preview moves under the grid below 1024 px.

Accessibility
Matrix is an ARIA grid; each cell names zone, category and granted or not. Category color always pairs with its name.

n-AtlasCanon.text:
Interaction and keys
Read-only canon from the Bible, in numeric order. Department list filters the Roles table. Org extensions live only in free .50 to .99 ranges and never change a canon row.

Responsive
Department list sits beside the table above 1024 px and above it below.

Accessibility
Department list uses aria-current. Codes sit in mono chips beside plain names. Provenance badge names the source.

n-AtlasMatrix.text:
Interaction and keys
90 coordinates, 10 departments by 9 gates. Every number opens its records in one click; arrows move between cells and Enter opens. Measure switch changes the count.

Responsive
Matrix scrolls in its region at every width; filters wrap.

Accessibility
Matrix is a grid with row and column headers; blank cells read No records. Table view is the accessible alternative.

n-AtlasMembers.text:
Interaction and keys
Invite with I. Role change is inline per row with Undo. Visibility table mirrors Section 4.5.9 so admins see what each role sees.

Responsive
Settings layout: section list left; below 768 px the list becomes a menu button and tables scroll in regions.

Accessibility
Section list is nav with aria-current. Tables have captions. MFA status is icon plus word.

n-AtlasWhiteLabel.text:
Interaction and keys
Brand step of the white-label wizard. Accent picker runs the contrast gate live and blocks a failing save. Preview shows the tenant change on real components. Sticky save bar appears when dirty; Cmd or Ctrl+S saves.

Responsive
Form 640 px with preview beside it above 1024 px and below it under that.

Accessibility
Contrast checks are text results. Unsaved status is a live region. Brand slots name their exact sizes and formats.

n-AtlasSecurity.text:
Interaction and keys
Every setting shows where its value comes from and who changed it. Locked at organization level for lower scopes. Extra settings sit behind More so 7 or fewer fields show first.

Responsive
Single 640 px column at every width.

Accessibility
Radio group and switches use native inputs with labels. Accordion headers are buttons with aria-expanded.

n-AtlasBilling.text:
Interaction and keys
Owners only; Admins never see this page (Section 4.5.9). Change Plan is the one primary action.

Responsive
Single column up to 880 px; tiles reflow 3, 2, 1.

Accessibility
Card number shows last four only. Invoice table has a caption and status words.

n-AtlasPrivacy.text:
Interaction and keys
Data requests show their respond-by date; held deletions explain why. Export All Data runs in the background and notifies when ready.

Responsive
Single column up to 880 px; tables scroll in regions on phones.

Accessibility
Classification table explains display rules in words. Legal hold alert is role status.

n-AtlasCommand.text:
Interaction and keys
Cmd or Ctrl+K anywhere. Results group by Actions, Records, Settings and People; arrows move, Enter runs, Escape closes. The last 50 viewed records show before typing. Operators like kind: and is:blocked filter.

Responsive
Dialog 640 px wide, full width minus 16 px gutters on phones.

Accessibility
Combobox with listbox results; focus is trapped in the dialog and returns on close. Background is inert.

n-AtlasStates.text:
Interaction and keys
Every region has its own empty, error and refusal state. Empty states are one sentence and one button. Errors name the field, problem and fix. Refusals show NO_ANSWER, UNRATIFIED or REFUSE with the reason; 403 renders as 404.

Responsive
Grid of states reflows from two columns to one below 900 px.

Accessibility
Errors use role alert; refusals use role status. Retry buttons say what they retry.

n-CompassToday.text:
Interaction and keys
One primary action: the clock button, which changes with state. Geofence status shows before the tap. Tasks swipe right to complete, left to snooze, with buttons for both. Context picker switches project and scope. Supervisors see the Crew tab.

Responsive
Fluid from 320 to 430 pt; on tablet the sections become two columns. Text holds at 200 percent font scale.

Accessibility
48 pt minimum targets. Landmarks: header, main, nav. Clock state changes are announced. Tab bar uses aria-current.

n-CompassClock.text:
Interaction and keys
States: outside geofence (waits), at venue (Clock In, 1 tap), on shift (Break, Clock Out), on break (End Break). Haptic plus 120 ms visual confirmation. Live Activity offers Break and Clock Out from the lock screen. Double clock-in on another device is refused.

Responsive
Same layout at 390 and 430 pt; tablet centers the column.

Accessibility
Clock state is a live region. Geofence status is text plus icon. Clock Out uses the danger style but stays a single tap with Undo.

n-CompassKiosk.text:
Interaction and keys
Shared device: worker enters a 4-digit PIN, photo on punch, one person per PIN. Exiting needs a supervisor passkey. Opens in Sunlight for outdoor gates.

Responsive
Keypad stays 3 by 4 with 64 pt keys at every size; tablet centers it.

Accessibility
PIN progress is announced as digits entered, never the digits. Keys have labels, including Delete last digit.

n-CompassShift.text:
Interaction and keys
Shift card offers calendar and wallet in 1 tap. Swap request lists only qualified, free people; nobody approves their own swap. Withdraw is available until approved.

Responsive
Single column; tablet shows the swap form beside the card.

Accessibility
Form fields are labeled; help text explains eligibility. Back button names its destination.

n-CompassTask.text:
Interaction and keys
Checklist items are rows. Photo proof captures inline when required. Complete Task or swipe right from Today; works offline and queues.

Responsive
Photo grid stays 3 across; tablet widens the column.

Accessibility
Checklist is a fieldset with a legend and count. Photos have time-stamped labels.

n-CompassIncident.text:
Interaction and keys
Three steps. Step 1 opens as a sheet over whatever screen is showing, from the Report Incident action anywhere: type grid; then confirm location (filled automatically), add photo or voice note and send. Critical types use hold to send. Works offline with a visible queue. Target under 30 s.

Responsive
Type grid is 2 or 3 across by width; map scales to the column.

Accessibility
The sheet is a modal dialog and the screen behind it is inert. Step and progress are announced. Hold to send has a text explanation and an accessible alternative long-press duration setting.

n-CompassInspection.text:
Interaction and keys
One item per card with large Pass and Fail. Fail requires a photo and a note before continuing. Sign-off unlocks after the last item. Average under 5 s per item.

Responsive
Single column; tablet shows the item list beside the current card.

Accessibility
Pass and Fail are buttons with text. Failed alert is role alert.

n-CompassScan.text:
Interaction and keys
Opens from the center tab. Mode picker in the scan sheet: Asset, Receiving, Credential. Continuous mode counts each scan with a haptic, then a batch review. NFC button reads tags.

Responsive
Viewfinder fills the width; review table fits 320 pt and up.

Accessibility
Each scan result is announced politely; failures assertively. Mode picker is a segmented radio group.

n-CompassShow.text:
Interaction and keys
Show mode: always dark, screen kept awake, large type, haptic before each cue. Cues sync with Atlas in under 500 ms. Only the stage manager advances cues.

Responsive
Large type scales up on tablet for arm's-length reading.

Accessibility
Current cue and countdown are a live region announced at each cue change, not every second.

n-CompassDaySheet.text:
Interaction and keys
Day sheet is cached for offline. Now marker follows the clock. Contacts call or message in 1 tap.

Responsive
Single column; tablet shows contacts beside the schedule.

Accessibility
Times are text in a list; the current entry is marked with text, not color only.

n-CompassCodes.text:
Interaction and keys
Global codes, 14 in canon order; protocols by operational domain. Steps name services and fill agencies from the venue jurisdiction (Miami Fire-Rescue, Miami Police Department). Offline.

Responsive
Single column; tablet shows the code list beside the open card.

Accessibility
Every swatch sits beside its code word; color never stands alone. Steps are an ordered list.

n-CompassRadio.text:
Interaction and keys
Your channel at the top. Emergency channel reminder. Plan sorted by zone then channel. Offline.

Responsive
Table fits 320 pt with wrapping notes.

Accessibility
Table has a caption and headers. Emergency note is role note with text.

n-CompassOffline.text:
Interaction and keys
Everything works offline; this queue shows what will send, in order. Conflicts wait for the person and show both values. Nothing is silently lost.

Responsive
Single column; tablet shows the conflict beside the queue.

Accessibility
Offline banner is a status region. Conflict choices are radio buttons with full values read out.

n-CompassProfile.text:
Interaction and keys
Show My Badge brightens the screen and shows the offline QR; also in Wallet. Expiring certifications warn 30 days ahead with a 1-tap upload.

Responsive
Single column; tablet shows certifications beside identity.

Accessibility
Badge QR has a text alternative with the credential key. Expiry status is text.

n-CompassMore.text:
Interaction and keys
More menu in the Section 4.5.7 order: Incidents, Inspections, Logistics, Show, Expenses, Reference (Emergency codes, Radio channels, Venue maps, SOPs), Offline queue, Profile and certifications, Settings. External users see role-specific additions.

Responsive
List rows are 52 pt; tablet uses two columns.

Accessibility
Nav landmark with headings for groups. Counts are part of each link's accessible name.

n-GatewayHome.text:
Interaction and keys
Up Next card leads with countdown, call time, address, parking, contact and what to bring; 1 tap to directions, calendar or wallet. Needs You feed acts inline. Recommendations explain how ranking works. Search sits at the top.

Responsive
Top bar on desktop; below 768 px the five destinations move to a bottom tab bar. Up Next and the feed stack below 900 px.

Accessibility
Landmarks: banner, main, nav. Each feed item's action names the item. Countdown text updates without being announced every minute.

n-GatewayExplore.text:
Interaction and keys
For You feed, filter chips, list or map, Saved and Alerts. Cards lead with role, pay, date and place. On phones swipe right to save and left to pass, with buttons for both. Rate on Request when no pay is posted.

Responsive
Gallery reflows from 3 cards to 1. Filter chips wrap onto more lines on phones; the Cards and Map switch sits with the filters.

Accessibility
Chips are toggle buttons with aria-pressed. Map view has the list as its alternative.

n-GatewayOpportunity.text:
Interaction and keys
Requirements check shows a green mark when the person qualifies or exactly what is missing, with the fix. Pay shows before applying. Apply in 3 taps or fewer with a complete profile.

Responsive
Two columns above 900 px; the check panel moves above the description on phones.

Accessibility
Requirement status is icon plus word. Apply is disabled only by missing requirements and says why.

n-GatewaySaved.text:
Interaction and keys
Saved opportunities and saved-search alerts with push and email switches. New Alert saves the current filters.

Responsive
Saved cards and alerts stack on phones.

Accessibility
Switches are labeled inputs. Alert counts are text.

n-GatewayApply.text:
Interaction and keys
One-step apply with a profile snapshot. Each shared field is a visible toggle before sending. Drafts save automatically. No resumes.

Responsive
Single 640 px column.

Accessibility
Sharing toggles are switches with labels. Draft saved is a status region.

n-GatewayBid.text:
Interaction and keys
Sealed line-item bid; nobody sees another bidder. Unpriced lines go as No Bid, never zero. Drafts save. Submit Sealed Bid locks the bid until the deadline.

Responsive
Bid grid scrolls in its region; actions wrap.

Accessibility
Grid cells have headers. Deadline is text with time zone.

n-GatewaySlate.text:
Interaction and keys
Agency picks named staff from its roster; only staff with verified required certifications can be included. Positions counter shows filled of needed.

Responsive
Single column up to 760 px.

Accessibility
Roster rows are checkboxes labeled with name and role; certification status is text.

n-GatewayApplications.text:
Interaction and keys
Work, Applications tab: board by application state, read-only for the applicant: no add buttons, cards open but do not move. Offers carry a banner with the answer-by date.

Responsive
Board scrolls sideways; on phones it becomes a state-grouped list.

Accessibility
Columns are labeled lists with counts.

n-GatewayOffer.text:
Interaction and keys
Accept, Counter or Decline. Counter sends a new rate and note; Decline asks for a shared reason. Terms show classification and pay basis per the engagement canon (Independent Contractor, Day Rate, Per Engagement).

Responsive
Terms and timeline stack on phones; actions go full width.

Accessibility
Mode changes move focus to the new form heading. Timeline is an ordered list with the current stage marked in text.

n-GatewayOnboarding.text:
Interaction and keys
Checklist with progress and minutes per item. Items already verified with this org check themselves off. Camera capture crops documents automatically. Blocking items gate the first shift.

Responsive
Single 640 px column.

Accessibility
Each item states blocking or optional in text. Progress bar has a text value.

n-GatewayClient.text:
Interaction and keys
Client tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. Approvals inline with A. Change orders show amount and impact.

Responsive
Content and timeline stack below 900 px; tabs scroll.

Accessibility
Tabs use the ARIA tabs pattern. Stat tiles read value and caption.

n-GatewayVendor.text:
Interaction and keys
Vendor tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. PO, dock slot, advance and invoice status on one screen. Payment tracker shows held invoices plainly.

Responsive
Same responsive pattern as every engagement page.

Accessibility
Insurance expiry alert is role alert. Codes in mono beside plain words.

n-GatewayContractor.text:
Interaction and keys
Contractor tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. Invoice drafts from accepted deliverables. Classification states 1099-NEC.

Responsive
Same responsive pattern.

Accessibility
Deliverable rows show state as icon and word.

n-GatewayCrew.text:
Interaction and keys
Crew tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. Onboarding progress and shifts lead. Employee classification states W-2 payroll; overtime at 1.5x after 40 hours (OTR-001).

Responsive
Same responsive pattern; shift cards stack.

Accessibility
Progress bar has a text value. Shift cards are articles with headings.

n-GatewayStaff.text:
Interaction and keys
Staff tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. Training and briefings first; agency staff see that pay comes from their agency.

Responsive
Same responsive pattern.

Accessibility
Briefing items state minutes and blocking in text.

n-GatewayArtist.text:
Interaction and keys
Artist tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. Set time, load-in, fee, hospitality and guest list on Overview. Advance reconciles rider needs against venue capability.

Responsive
Same responsive pattern.

Accessibility
Reconciliation results are words, not color.

n-GatewayRepresentative.text:
Interaction and keys
Roster of represented artists with delegated scopes and expiry. Acts only within scopes; everything else goes to the artist.

Responsive
Table scrolls in a region on phones.

Accessibility
Scopes are text in a table with headers.

n-GatewaySponsor.text:
Interaction and keys
Sponsor tabs in Section 4.5.8 order. Entitlements with status, asset approvals, activation schedule. Proof of performance arrives at Gate 8.

Responsive
Same responsive pattern.

Accessibility
Progress bar has a text value; entitlement table has a caption.

n-GatewaySchedule.text:
Interaction and keys
Work, Upcoming across orgs in calendar and list; calendar feed subscribes in 1 tap; any item adds to a calendar.

Responsive
Calendar and agenda stack on phones; phones default to the agenda list.

Accessibility
Calendar grid has day headers; events are listed in text.

n-GatewayDocuments.text:
Interaction and keys
Vault across orgs with expiry. Signing shows the document, the attestation and the signature pad; Sign and Finish creates a signed certificate.

Responsive
Vault and signing stack on phones; the signature pad fills the width.

Accessibility
Signature pad has a typed-name alternative. File previewer pages are labeled.

n-GatewayMoney.text:
Interaction and keys
Overview: earned, pending, next payment. Invoices draft from approved days; submit in under 60 s. Tracker reads Submitted, Approved, Scheduled, Paid with dates. XOS never holds funds.

Responsive
Tiles reflow 3, 2, 1; forms are single column.

Accessibility
Tracker stages are an ordered list with dates as text. Amounts use Money formatting.

n-GatewayMessages.text:
Interaction and keys
Threads per engagement and per org; attachments, reactions, Cmd or Ctrl+Enter sends. Reply from the push notification without opening the app.

Responsive
Split view on desktop; on phones the list and thread are separate screens.

Accessibility
Thread list is a listbox; messages are a log region.

n-GatewayProfile.text:
Interaction and keys
Per-field visibility: Private, Shared on application, Public. Strength meter names the next improvement. Skills tag canon roles. Availability calendar shares on application.

Responsive
Editor and availability stack on phones.

Accessibility
Visibility controls are labeled selects per field. Strength is a text percentage.

n-GatewayPublicProfile.text:
Interaction and keys
Public profile at /u/handle with EPK media, links and ratings from completed engagements, with public replies.

Responsive
Media grid reflows to one column on phones.

Accessibility
Media items have labels; ratings are text.

n-GatewayCompany.text:
Interaction and keys
Company account at /c/handle. Team with account roles: Owner, Admin, Finance, Member. Capabilities tagged by canon; insurance shared with each org.

Responsive
Tabs scroll; cards reflow.

Accessibility
Role table has a caption. Tabs use the ARIA pattern.

n-GatewaySettings.text:
Interaction and keys
Personal settings in Section 4.5.6 order. Sharing consents per org are reversible. Payout details stored as Restricted and shown as last four only.

Responsive
Section list becomes a menu button below 768 px.

Accessibility
Revoke is a danger button that names the org. Payout form fields are labeled.

n-GatewayAdvanceToken.text:
Interaction and keys
No account needed; token plus access code. Answers save as typed. Seven sections with a stepper. At the end the person is offered an account.

Responsive
Single 720 px column.

Accessibility
Stepper is an ordered list. File drop has a button alternative.

n-GatewaySignToken.text:
Interaction and keys
Sign with a token, then claim a Gateway account by passkey; records link by verified email. Not Now keeps the token flow.

Responsive
Single 720 px column.

Accessibility
Success message is role status. Claim is optional and says so.

n-FlowClock-1.text:
Step 1
Outside the geofence the button waits and says why. 0 taps possible.

n-FlowClock-2.text:
Step 2
Inside the venue: Clock In is 1 tap, under 2 s from unlock. App Shortcut, Action Button and quick tile do the same.

n-FlowClock-3.text:
Step 3
On shift: timer, Break and Clock Out each 1 tap. Live Activity mirrors them on the lock screen.

n-FlowClock-4.text:
Step 4
On break: End Break 1 tap. A forgotten clock-out closes at 16 hours and is flagged for review.

n-FlowScan-1.text:
Step 1
Center tab or the app icon's long-press opens Receiving: 1 tap.

n-FlowScan-2.text:
Step 2
Continuous mode: each scan counts with a haptic and no tap. Target 30 items in under 60 s.

n-FlowScan-3.text:
Step 3
Batch review shows shorts against the PO; Receive is 1 tap, so 2 taps total for the batch.

n-FlowIncident-1.text:
Step 1
Choose the type from the grid: 1 tap. Critical types are marked.

n-FlowIncident-2.text:
Step 2
Location fills from position; confirm with 1 tap or drag the pin.

n-FlowIncident-3.text:
Step 3
Voice note is transcribed; Hold to Send for critical types. Under 30 s, offline included, queued if needed.

n-FlowUpNext-1.text:
Step 1
Home opens on the Up Next card: countdown, call time, address. 0 taps.

n-FlowUpNext-2.text:
Step 2
Every detail in a bottom sheet: 1 tap. Directions, contacts, parking, what to bring.

n-FlowUpNext-3.text:
Step 3
Add to Wallet or Calendar: 1 tap. The wallet pass works offline.

n-FlowPayment-1.text:
Step 1
Invoice drafts from approved days; open and confirm: 2 taps, under 60 s.

n-FlowPayment-2.text:
Step 2
Submitted shows in the tracker immediately with the date; push at each stage.

n-FlowPayment-3.text:
Step 3
Paid with date and rail, last four only. 0 taps after submission.

n-FlowRequirements-1.text:
Step 1
The requirements check names exactly what is missing and the fix.

n-FlowRequirements-2.text:
Step 2
Camera adds the certificate; the check turns green without leaving the page.

n-FlowRequirements-3.text:
Step 3
Apply with the saved profile in 3 taps: Apply, review shared fields, Submit.

n-FlowSidebars.text: Defaults per Section 4.5.2: Producer opens Production; Finance Lead opens Commercial; Production Coordinator opens Operations; Department Head opens Production and Operations; Field Supervisor opens Operations and People. The prompt names no default for Org Owner or Org Admin, so all groups start collapsed for them. Reset to Role Default restores this layout.

n-FlowAtlasPhone.text: Atlas below 768 px: bottom bar with Home, Inbox, Search, My Work, Menu. Menu opens the full sidebar as a sheet. Same Home screen file, rendered at 390 px.

n-FlowGatewayPhone.text: Gateway below 768 px: five destinations in a bottom tab bar (Home, Explore, Work, Money, Messages). Avatar menu holds Profile, Documents, Settings, Switch org, Help, Sign out.

n-FlowGatewayDesktop.text: Gateway on desktop: the same five destinations sit in the top bar with the org brand; no sidebar. Comfortable density, 14 px base text.

n-WLAtlasHarbor.text: Harbor Light Events: Light theme, accent #0F7B6C, rounded radius scale (control 10, card 12, chip 6). Only tokens change; markup and components are identical to Northwind Live.

n-WLGatewayHarbor.text: Same Gateway Home file with the Harbor Light Events token set. The custom domain shows only this org.

n-WLCompassHarbor.text: Same Compass Today file with the Harbor Light Events token set; Sunlight still available from the Theme tweak.

n-WLAtlasNorthwind.text: Northwind Live default: Dark theme, accent #5B63E8, default radius scale.

n-ProtoClock.text:
Interaction and keys
Press Play, then Next and Back to step through clock-in states exactly as drawn above, with the tap count for each step in the header. Next on the last step starts over.

Responsive
The phone frame is 390 by 844 pt; the same screens reflow at 430 pt and on tablet in the Compass and Gateway size sheets.

Accessibility
The step header is a polite live region, so each step is announced; Back is disabled on the first step.
